guidance: Build a golden image pipeline to ensure all base AMIs are consistently hardened and up to date. Each image should start from the latest patched OS, apply CIS benchmark hardening, and pre-install required agents (SSM, anti-malware, FIM). Use EC2 Image Builder to automate this on a schedule, and enforce approved AMI usage via AWS Config rules (approved-amis-by-tag or approved-amis-by-id). EC2 Image Builder is free — you only pay for the resources generated.
how_to_check: Is a golden image pipeline implemented and widely adopted? Are teams prevented from launching arbitrary AMIs? Are AWS Config rules in place to detect instances launched from non-approved AMIs? For more information, please refer to the documentation.
